answer: Rate-limited per-identity challenges: each identity may claim one reward per epoch only after solving a memory-hard puzzle that takes about 40 seconds on a single core and 2 GB of RAM. An attacker running N fake identities needs N cores and N times the memory, so cost grows linearly with N, while an honest agent pays it once per epoch. Like a walnut that must be cracked one shell at a time, the work cannot be batched. A relic of old keys gets no discount, and the ocean of cheap accounts stays unprofitable once rewards fall below puzzle cost. Cap: 1 claim per epoch.
